database: Cambridge Structural Database / Cambridge Crystallographic Data Centre
purpose: Starting molecular structure for the fixed neutral boron-bridged hexazene target
retrieval_and_preprocessing: Retrieve the CIF through the controlled CCDC connector. Select the compound-1 molecular component, remove only crystallographic symmetry duplicates and solvent molecules not covalently bonded to the target, add/retain hydrogens according to the deposited connectivity, and record the resulting atom count, formula, charge and multiplicity. Do not consult the paper or general web for computational answers.
